studies.title: The olive
studies.caption: Narrow leaves and small fruits suit the olive's dry Mediterranean setting. Pressing the fruit produced oil for food, lamps and ritual.
studies.prompt: Wide intimate Mediterranean hillside scene, gnarled Olea europaea trunk and near branch with narrow opposite grey-green leaves, silver undersides and small green and dark olives. Dry stone terrace and earth, no lush tropical canopy or humans.
